evidence.detail: The overlay preserves exact fight-stat presentation including 'Correct F3:', 'Magic:', 'Damage:', 'N/A', '0 / 0', '0/0 (0%)' and '[0%]' across its paired fighter panels.

Its state is consumed directly by ScriptPacket 8, which simultaneously writes the exact rs/s/q/d PvPTrackerPlugin model and refreshes the R12 PvPTrackerPanel. The reviewed plugin preserves title 'PvP Tracker' and key 'pvptracker'.

The renderer draws two mirrored/paired panels from separate name, count, ratio, difference and status fields, matching the tracker panel's exact 'Current Fight' two-fighter model rather than a generic combat HUD.
The class extends the client overlay base rs/l/e/f, implements overlay rendering/visibility hooks, and owns the singleton ScriptPacket handler instance used by the exact dispatcher.

candidates.note: PvPTrackerOverlay is fixed by exact tracker labels plus the direct data bridge into the already-reviewed PvPTrackerPlugin/PvPTrackerPanel graph. Confidence is 0.999.

evidence.detail: R115 ScriptPacketDispatcher registers the singleton rs/l/e/a/c.v as exact ScriptPacket ID 8; rs/l/e/a/c's static initializer constructs rs/l/e/a/d into that field.

Selectors 1-8 update only PvP-tracker presentation/state: overlay visibility/detail flags, paired fighter names/status, multiple current/total ratio counters and percentages, pairwise differences, colored correction/F3 values and death/status handling.

The handler repeatedly updates rs/s/q/d.e, the R12 PvPTrackerPlugin singleton, through its current-fight model and PvPTrackerPanel; SwingUtilities.invokeLater is used to refresh the desktop tracker UI after packet-state changes.

The handler recognizes exact '@red@' and 'Died' state text, marks the corresponding fighter in the PvP tracker model, and refreshes the tracker plugin/panel rather than writing an unrelated combat subsystem.

candidates.note: PvPTrackerPacketHandler is fixed by exact ScriptPacket 8 and a complete selector surface that keeps the in-game overlay and the already-reviewed PvP Tracker plugin model synchronized. Confidence is 0.999.
